text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit parking at all times on both sides of Jopling Avenue North, between Bloor Street West and Mervyn Avenue. The proposed prohibition is a result of consultation between staff and the Ward Councillor, to address concerns regarding long term parking on the street by non-residents.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Jopling Avenue North, between Bloor Street West and Mervyn Avenue.
